articles.summary: HAMMOND, La., July 24, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First Guaranty Bancshares, Inc. ("First Guaranty") (NASDAQ: FGBI), the holding company for First Guaranty Bank, announced its key developments and unaudited financial results for the second quarter and six months ending June 30, 2024. Key developments are as follows: First Guaranty is initiating changes to its business strategy.
